## Checklist

- [ ] `npm run build` passes
- [ ] `npm test` passes
- [ ] Types are correct (`npm run typecheck`)
- [ ] `npm run format:check` passes (or run `npm run format` on touched files)
- [ ] Commit messages follow [conventional commits](https://www.conventionalcommits.org/)
- [ ] Templates updated if applicable
- [ ] Wiki / `README.md` updated when behavior or public API changes ([docs parity](https://github.com/prototypdigital/bluetemberg/wiki))
- [ ] Prefer smaller, reviewable PRs when you can split work without breaking the build
